home.title: e-Skupština
home.intro: Association assembly sessions and voting online. Sign in to join a session.
home.noProviders: Sign-in is not configured. An administrator must set up Certilia or Okta.
home.guestLink: Join as a guest (watch only, no voting)
home.joinHelp: Enter the session code from your invitation.
home.guestNotice: You are signed in as a guest: you can watch the session but not vote.
home.notMemberNotice: You are not on the list of members with voting rights: you can watch but not vote.

guest.title: Join as a guest
guest.intro: Guests can watch the session but cannot vote.
guest.disabled: Guest access is not enabled right now.
guest.codeSent: We sent a sign-in code to {email}.
guest.name: Full name
guest.privacy: Your name and email are used only for this session and deleted after the minutes are sealed, per the association's rules. If that address has a Gravatar picture, it is shown next to your name.

admin.importHelp: Import the member register (CSV, semicolon or comma separated). Required columns: oib, ime_prezime. Optional: email, datum_rodenja, datum_pristupanja, datum_prestanka, kategorija, pravo_glasa (da/ne). Existing members are updated by OIB; nobody is deleted.
admin.name: Name
admin.usersHelp: People who have signed in at least once. Administrators manage members and sessions and are the only ones who can enable guest access.
admin.categoriesHelp: The category is required and, per the statute, decides voting rights: {list}.

importErrors.missingColumns: columns oib and ime_prezime are missing
importErrors.votingRightConflict: pravo_glasa does not match the membership category

assembly.notJoined: Enter the code from your invitation to join this session.
assembly.guestWatchOnly: You are a guest: you can watch the session but not vote.
assembly.observerOnly: You are not on the list of members with voting rights, so you are watching only.
assembly.notOpenYet: The session has not opened yet. This page refreshes on its own.
assembly.cannotVote: Voting is in progress. You have no vote in this session.
assembly.noAgenda: The agenda has not been published yet.
assembly.restricted: Only the chair and committee see this result; it will be in the minutes.
assembly.sealed: The minutes are sealed and were sent to everyone who voted.

vote.confirm: Confirm your vote? It cannot be changed once sent.
vote.receiptMismatch: The server's receipt does not match the ballot your browser made. Tell the committee.
vote.secrecy: Your ballot is encrypted in your browser. Nobody, the server included, can read it until enough committee members open it together, and by then it can no longer be linked to you.
vote.receiptOtherDevice: The receipt is saved on the device you voted from.
vote.receiptsHelp: Keep them. After sealing, check they appear in the minutes' appendix or on the Verify page.
vote.confirmPublic: This is a public vote: your name will be published with your vote. Confirm your vote? It cannot be changed once sent.
vote.publicBallot: Public vote: after counting, your name is published with your vote. Until then the ballot is encrypted like a secret one.

manage.title: Title
manage.quorumHelp: Per your statute, e.g. 50 = more than half of the members with voting rights.
manage.thresholdHelp: This many committee members must take part to open the ballots and seal the minutes.
manage.sealMethodHelp: Certilia: qualified electronic signature in the Certilia app (each signer needs a remote certificate). Own keys: free, but without the legal weight of a qualified signature.
manage.statutConfirm: I confirm the association's statute allows assembly sessions and voting by electronic means.
manage.itemPlaceholder: e.g. Adoption of the 2025 financial report
manage.questionPlaceholder: e.g. The 2025 financial report is adopted.
manage.checkStatut: Confirmed that the statute allows an electronic session
manage.openAssemblyConfirm: Once open, the settings and committee can no longer change. Continue?
manage.sendInvitationsConfirm: Email the invitation to all members?
manage.guestsBlocked: Guests are not allowed (only an administrator can change this).
manage.closeAssemblyConfirm: Close the session? No more voting will be possible.
manage.readyForZapisnik: All results are confirmed. You can create the minutes.
manage.waitingForCommittee: Waiting for the committee to count and confirm every result.
manage.sealedAt: Minutes sealed on {date} and sent to the voters.
manage.closeQuestionConfirm: Close voting? No more votes can be cast on this question.
manage.awaitingCount: Waiting for the committee to open the ballots.
manage.name: Name
manage.removeConfirm: Remove this guest from the session?
manage.committeeHelp: Committee members open the ballots and seal the minutes together. Each must create their key on the Committee page before the session opens.
manage.settingsLocked: Quorum: more than {percent}% · committee: {k} needed · sealing: {method}. Settings can only change while the session is in preparation.
manage.videoUrlHelp: For simultaneous picture and sound (e.g. Jitsi, Zoom, Teams). The link goes into the invitation and onto the session page.
manage.ballotHelpPublic: Per the statute, voting is public: names are published with votes. Secret only if the assembly decided so.
manage.ballotHelpSecret: Per the statute, voting is secret. A public vote publishes each voter's name with their vote.
manage.noticeHelp: Per the statute, the invitation with the proposed agenda goes out at least {days} days before the session. Set the date and agenda first.

committee.title: Committee
committee.regenerateConfirm: Create a new key? The old one will stop working.
committee.keysRegistered: Your key was created and downloaded. Keep the file safe.
committee.wrongKeyFile: This is not your key for this session.
committee.confirmed: Your browser got the same result; your confirmation is recorded.
committee.keyHelp: The key is created in your browser and downloaded as a file. The server only receives the public part. Without the file you cannot take part in counting.
committee.keyNotRegistered: You have not created a key yet. The session cannot open until every committee member has one.
committee.countHelp: After voting closes, at least {k} members submit their key shares. Then each member re-counts in their own browser and confirms the result.
committee.waitingForOthers: Waiting for the rest of the committee.
committee.sealHelpOwn: Each member signs the minutes with the key from their file.
committee.sealHelpCertilia: Download the latest version of the minutes, sign it in the Certilia app (or at websign.certilia.com) and upload the signed file. Members sign one after another.
committee.notAllPublished: All results must be confirmed first.
committee.sealed: The minutes are sealed and were sent to the voters.
committee.downloadLatest: Download the latest version to sign
committee.youSigned: You have signed. Waiting for the rest of the committee.

verify.title: Verify
verify.pdfHelp: Choose the minutes PDF you received by email. The file is not uploaded; only its SHA-256 fingerprint is compared.
verify.pdfUnknown: This PDF is not minutes from this system, or it was changed.
verify.originalNotSigned: This is the unsigned version. You received the sealed version by email.
verify.qesHelp: Check the qualified signatures in Adobe Acrobat Reader or with the EU DSS validator (ec.europa.eu/digital-building-blocks/DSS/webapp-demo/validation).
verify.receiptHelp: Enter the receipt you got when you voted.
verify.receiptCounted: The ballot was stored and counted: "{question}" ({assembly}).
verify.receiptStored: The ballot was stored and is waiting to be counted: "{question}" ({assembly}).

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.wrongStatus: That is not possible right now.
errors.cannotChangeOwnRole: You cannot change your own role.
errors.alreadyInCommittee: This person is already on the committee.
errors.needOptions: At least two options are needed.
errors.statutNotConfirmed: First confirm that the statute allows an electronic session.
errors.committeeTooSmall: The committee has too few members.
errors.committeeKeysMissing: Not every committee member has created a key.
errors.badCode: Unknown code, or the session is not open.
errors.removed: You were removed from this session.
errors.notEligible: You have no vote in this session.
errors.privateKeyUploaded: Rejected: that looked like a private key.
errors.signingKeyRequired: This sealing method also needs a signing key. Create a new key.
errors.alreadySubmitted: You have already submitted your shares.
errors.resultMismatch: Your browser got a different result from the server. Do not confirm; tell the committee.
errors.noOib: Signing with Certilia needs your OIB: sign in with Certilia or be on the member register.
errors.signerMismatch: The PDF was not signed with your certificate.
errors.pdfModified: The PDF is not a signed copy of the latest minutes.
errors.pdfNoNewSignature: The PDF has no new signature.
errors.pdfBadByteRange: The signature does not cover the whole minutes.
errors.pdfBadSignature: The signature in the PDF is not valid.
errors.useMemberLogin: This address belongs to a member: sign in with Certilia or Okta.
errors.videoRequired: The statute requires a video call: add the link in the settings.
errors.signerRolesMissing: Give committee members the minutes-signer roles the statute requires.
errors.scheduleFirst: Set the session date and time first.
errors.noticeTooShort: There are fewer days left before the session than the statute requires for the invitation. Move the date.
errors.agendaFirst: Add the proposed agenda first: the invitation must include it.
